---
title: "DuBois-Figure Source"
format: html
---

 

```{r}
source("data_cleaned.R")

approval_data <- pima_hmda |>
  filter(action_taken %in% c(1, 3)) |>
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      action_taken == 1 ~ "Loan Originated",
      action_taken == 3 ~ "Denied"
    )
  ) |>
  count(outcome) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n),
    label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)
  )

ggplot(approval_data, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = outcome)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "#F4E8D0", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "#F4E8D0",
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Loan Originated" = "#B83227",
      "Denied" = "#252525"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = NULL,
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#F4E8D0", color = NA
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#F4E8D0", color = NA
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      color = "#252525", face = "bold", size = 18
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#252525"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#252525"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#252525"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
ggsave(
  filename = "loan_outcomes.svg",
  plot = last_plot(),
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  units = "in"
)
```
